description: This file defines a custom validation annotation @EnumValue for use with Java Bean Validation API, specifying that a field's value must be one of the constants in a specified Enum class.

classes.name: EnumValue
classes.description: A custom annotation interface for validating that a field's value is one of the Enum constants defined in a specified Enum class, used with validation frameworks.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Default validation message key for the annotation.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Validation groups associated with the annotation.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Additional payloads associated with the annotation.

methods.name: enumClass
methods.description: Specifies the Enum class that the annotated field's value should correspond to.
